changelog: Downloads now run on a native engine: they keep downloading in the background — even with battery saver on — instead of stalling when you leave the app.
Heads-up: downloads from earlier versions are not carried over and need to be downloaded again.
Picture-in-picture playback on Android — the PiP window shows just the video.
Fixed the home carousel staying paused after a touch-and-hold; autoplay resumes when you let go.
Player polish: tap the center to pause, seeking back from the end screen resumes playback, and the controls hide after 2 seconds.
Smoother keyboard and TV remote navigation across the app.
